cohort: Women whose pregnancy ended (irrespective of the location or duration of pregnancy) or who were admitted within 42 days of delivery in 54 referral level facilities in Nigeria.
finding: Hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP) affected 6.4% of the women, with gestational hypertension accounting for 49.8%, preeclampsia 9.5%, and eclampsia 7.0%, and were predicted by older age, poor education, extremes of parity, and previous C-section or miscarriage.
